title: ThangkaGrid Deity Iconometric Definition
description: Declarative iconometric ratio contract for Tibetan Thangka (Thigse / Thig-tshad) and Newari Paubha sacred geometric grids, expressed in scale-invariant Sor-mo (finger-width) and Yuka (barley-grain) units.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of the ThangkaGrid deity definition schema.

id.description: Machine-readable slug identifier for the deity preset.

english.description: Common English name of the deity.

wylie.description: Extended Wylie transliteration of the Tibetan name.

sanskrit.description: IAST Sanskrit name of the deity.

newari.description: Classical Nepal Bhasa / Newari name used in Paubha manuals.

classification.description: Canonical proportional class: 125-sor Enlightened Buddha (Tathagata), 120-sor Peaceful Bodhisattva/Goddess, or 96-sor Wrathful Dharmapala/Heruka.

lineage.description: Artistic tradition (e.g., Menri, Karma Gadri, Newari Paubha, Khyenri).

sourceText.description: Primary canonical treatise (e.g., Vaidurya dKar-po, Citralaksana, Kalacakra Tantra).

notes.description: Iconometric commentary on how total Sor-mo span maps to seated vs. standing planes.

baseUnit.description: Fundamental unit: Sor-mo (Tib. sor-mo, Skt. angula / finger-width).

yukaPerSor.description: Sub-units per Sor-mo: 1 sor = 8 yuka (Tib. nas / barley-grains).

sorPerTala.description: Sor-mo per Tala: 1 tala (Tib. mtho / face-length span) = 12 sor.

canonicalStandingSpanSor.description: Full canonical proportional category in Sor-mo (125 for Buddhas, 120 for Bodhisattvas, 96 for Wrathful).

seatedGridHeightSor.description: Total vertical height of the active seated/lunging figure + lotus throne in Sor-mo.

verticalSegments.description: Ordered vertical intervals along the central Brahmasutra from top crown jewel down to the lotus throne base.

topAnchor.description: Landmark ID at the top of this vertical segment.

bottomAnchor.description: Landmark ID at the bottom of this vertical segment.

sor.description: Whole Sor-mo (finger-width) measure for this interval.

horizontalWidths.description: Bilateral horizontal half-widths measured perpendicular to the Brahmasutra at named vertical anchors.

anchor.description: References a vertical anchor landmark ID.

halfWidthSor.description: Distance from the central Brahmasutra to either left or right landmark in whole Sor-mo.

yuka.description: Additional Yuka (1/8th sor) added to halfWidthSor.

asymmetricRightOffsetSor.description: Optional extension on the viewer's right (deity's left/right leg extension such as Lalitasana).

faceHalfWidthSor.description: Half-width of the face from central Brahmasutra to inner ear line (canonically 6 sor).

earWidthSor.description: Horizontal width of each ear helix beyond the facial boundary (canonically 2 sor).

earlobeBelowChinSor.description: How far the elongated earlobe (pendulous wisdom lobes) descends relative to the chin/jaw.

eyeLineBelowUrnaSor.description: Vertical distance from Urna (brow/third-eye) down to the horizontal pupil axis.

eyeInnerHalfSpanSor.description: Distance from central Brahmasutra to the inner tear duct (canthus) of each eye.

eyeLengthSor.description: Length of the bow-shaped / lotus-petal eye in Sor-mo.

eyeHeightYuka.description: Vertical opening of the eye in Yuka (1/8th sor; peaceful Buddha = 4 yuka, Tara = 5 yuka, Wrathful = 12 yuka).

noseHalfWidthSor.description: Half-width of the nostrils at the nose base anchor.

mouthBelowNoseBaseSor.description: Distance from the nose base down to the lip parting line.

urnaRadiusYuka.description: Radius of the Urna (mdzod-spu) curl between the eyebrows in Yuka.

enabled.description: Whether the central Brahmasutra deflects into a Tribhanga (triple-bend) spline.

headTiltDeg.description: Angular inclination of the head/facial axis in degrees.

neckDeflectionSor.description: Horizontal sway at the neck (mgrin-pa) in Sor-mo.

heartDeflectionSor.description: Horizontal sway at the heart chakra (thugs-ka) in Sor-mo.

waistDeflectionSor.description: Horizontal sway at the navel/waist (lte-ba) in Sor-mo.

hipDeflectionSor.description: Horizontal counter-sway at the pelvis/seat plane in Sor-mo.

sirascakra.description: Head nimbus / halo (Tib. dbu-kor, Skt. sirascakra).

karnasutra.description: Diagonal symmetry & construction lines (Tib. zur-thig, Skt. karnasutra) intersecting key anatomical anchors.

fromOffsetSor.description: Signed horizontal offset in Sor-mo from the anchor point (mirrored automatically to produce bilateral X-diagonals).

toOffsetSor.description: Signed horizontal offset in Sor-mo at the target anchor.
